message:
# Fieldnotes — editorial workspace delivered

**Fieldnotes now uses a complete source-backed editorial theme in the genuine TiddlyWiki 5.4.1 application.** The result preserves native notes, linking, search, tags, drafts, editing and server persistence. All eight supplied note bodies remain unchanged after the verification edits were restored.

The selected foundation is **Vanilla Paper 0.10.0**, from [BurningTreeC/vanilla-paper](https://github.com/BurningTreeC/vanilla-paper), exact revision `031a78d4d4187128c632f8a647fa05408eddc700`. Its 55 original files are byte-for-byte unchanged. Supported configuration selects its own Day/Night palettes and the native zero-duration animation setting. The full MIT notice is retained and embedded for offline export. No W1/W2/W3 exception, bespoke replacement UI, external runtime service, new font download or alternate data store was introduced.

## Open and run

From the assigned package:

```sh
cd /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w11/app
PORT=4411 ./start.sh
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:4411/`. The native server remains the authoritative editing path. The owned test server was stopped after final verification.

A native offline preview was built successfully: [index.html](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w11/app/wiki/output/index.html).

Use **Control Panel → Appearance → Palette** for Vanilla Paper Day or Vanilla Paper Night. Language and animation duration are available under **Control Panel → Info → Basics**. The default opens the original project index and bilingual interview in Day, English UI, with quiet native transitions.

## What the design contributes

Paper carries a recognisable editorial idea into populated work: a bounded serif reading sheet, warm surrounding field, fine margin rule, separate sans-serif navigation, and a ruled monospace editor. The long English/Chinese interview retains its full argument, exceptions and final unresolved question. The editor retains the native title, tags, wrapping formatting toolbar and confirm/discard controls at desktop, compact height and phone width.

The comparison included materially different mature directions:

| Direction | Observed advantage | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| Paper | Distinct reading, navigation and editing type roles; a consistent paper surface throughout the long note | Selected for the editorial research-studio goal |
| Notebook 1.4.1 | Centered denser sans-serif cards, persistent compact utility bar and expanding left navigation | Credible structural challenger; less distinct editorial reading voice for this brief |
| Ironworks 0.11.0 | Strong industrial grain, screw details and orange accents throughout populated work | Useful material challenger; variable texture behind prose competed with calm sustained reading |

The independent researcher supplied real public-demo captures and source evidence. The primary inspected the important returned comparisons, made the selection, integrated it, and personally viewed the assembled product. Paper’s demo runs a newer prerelease core; the target’s actual 5.4.1 checks provide the compatibility evidence.

## Verified behaviour and visual scope

- Followed the interview’s native link to the five-row evidence table and returned through the sidebar.
- Edited an English and a Chinese passage through the native pencil/editor/checkmark controls. Confirmed the actual server-file body and a subsequent browser reload. Restored the original text through the same controls and verified reload again.
- Started and cancelled an edit while preserving the existing note.
- Found the ledger through native search and used keyboard activation to open the result and its editor.
- Captured reading and editing in the full **2 palettes × 2 UI languages × 3 viewports** matrix: 1440×900, 1280×640 and 390×844, DPR 1. No document-width overflow was reported in those interview conditions.
- Personally inspected 12 representative settled reading/editor views covering both palettes, both interface languages and all three sizes, plus the source comparison, ledger, long-note ending, quiet-editor rechecks and final clean-start image.
- Operated normal and reduced-motion edit/cancel/sidebar episodes. The native quiet setting is saved. Final runtime reported no drafts, no active sync tasks and `dirty=false`.
- Verified all 55 original theme files against acquired hashes and all eight note bodies against the original fixtures; built the offline preview; restarted the final on-disk store and confirmed the correct theme, palette, language, quiet setting, eight notes and initial story.

The final result is shown in [final-delivery-1440.png](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w11/evidence/captures/final-delivery-1440.png). Representative dark compact reading and narrow editing are [settled-final-night-zh-1280-read.png](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w11/evidence/captures/settled-final-night-zh-1280-read.png) and [settled-final-night-zh-390-edit.png](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w11/evidence/captures/settled-final-night-zh-390-edit.png).

## Corrections and remaining limits

Actual failed attempts remain in the evidence. They include a trailing-newline exact-theme-title mismatch, an obsolete seed-filename assumption after native saving, a stale duplicate file selected by the first title-based assertion, premature transition captures, and locator/script corrections. The final store was cleaned while the server was stopped; archived original duplicate bytes remain available. Later successful checks are separate files, not replacements for failures.

Static screenshots and controlled operations establish the stated conditions. Natural-time video, physical phone keyboards, Safari/Firefox, broad WCAG or screen-reader conformance, narrow ledger-table acceptance, network-failure/retry recovery, sustained performance and end-user preference were not established. The source’s subdued secondary icons and metadata have not received a formal contrast audit. No claim of broad accessibility or owner acceptance is made.

The work is documented in [DESIGN.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w11/DESIGN.md), [VISUAL-REVIEW.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w11/VISUAL-REVIEW.md), [RESEARCH-REPORT.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w11/evidence/research/RESEARCH-REPORT.md), and [DELEGATION.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w11/DELEGATION.json). Exact command outputs, original tool exports, source archives, viewed-image responses, failed attempts and final verification records are retained under `evidence/`.
